Patient
Gender: Female.
Height: 5′ 5″.
Weight: 126 lbs.
Months Post-Op: 3.

Breast Augmentation Surgery
Procedure Type: Gummy Bear Breast Augmentation.
Implant Placement: Subfascial (on top of the muscle).
Incision Site: Inframammary.
Pre-Op Cup Size: 34B.
Post-Op Cup Size: 34C.
Implant Type: Mentor MemoryShape Gummy Bear Silicone Implant.
Profile: Medium Height Moderate Profile Implant.
Shape: Anatomic.
Implant Surface: Textured.
Left Implant Size: 215cc.
Right Implant Size: 215cc.

Doctor’s Comments Mentor MemoryShape Gummy Bear Anatomic (tear drop) shaped implants were used by Dr. Gregory Park, Oceanside plastic surgeon, for this breast enhancement surgery. This patient wanted to achieve natural appearing breasts and enhance her cup size to a C cup. 215 cc Medium Height Moderate profile anatomic breast implants were placed on top of the pectoralis muscles in a subfascial pockets. After breast augmentation this patient’s bra size was increased from 34B to 34C.
